title: Eye of Providence, Pyramid, Jachin–Boaz & Esoteric Threshold Architecture
status: documented history + later reception + Potatoverse structural comparison
purpose: Research the Eye of Providence, Great Seal reverse, unfinished pyramid, 1776, Jachin and Boaz, later Masonic/esoteric pillar symbolism, and their possible structural uses in the Potato House while separating documentation from interpretation.
epistemic_rule: Historical fact, later reception, structural comparison and speculative association must remain explicitly separated. Shared symbols or dates do not prove shared organization, influence or secret coordination.

great_seal.1776: The Roman-numeral date on the pyramid base refers to the Declaration of Independence / beginning of the American era, not to an officially stated esoteric event.
great_seal.adoption: The current Great Seal design was adopted by Congress on June 20, 1782 after several committees and revisions.
great_seal.reverse: The reverse shows an unfinished pyramid of thirteen courses with MDCCLXXVI on the base, an Eye of Providence in a radiant triangle above, Annuit Coeptis above the eye and Novus Ordo Seclorum below.
great_seal.official_explanation: Charles Thomson's explanation associates the pyramid with strength and duration, Providence with favoring the American cause, and Novus Ordo Seclorum with the beginning of a new American era.

early_eye.note: An Eye of Providence in a radiant triangle already appears in Pierre Eugène Du Simitière's 1776 Great Seal proposal before the final pyramid arrangement of 1782.

jachin_boaz.biblical_text: 1 Kings 7:21 places two named pillars at the Temple vestibule/porch: Jachin on the south/right and Boaz on the north/left.
jachin_boaz.names: Common Bible footnotes gloss Jachin approximately as 'he establishes' and Boaz as 'in him/it is strength'.

illuminati_1776.note: The Bavarian Illuminati was founded in 1776. The shared year with the Declaration/Great Seal base is a historical coincidence unless independent evidence demonstrates a causal or design connection.
illuminati_1776.boundary: Do not treat 1776 alone as evidence that the Great Seal encodes the Illuminati.

freemasonry.note: Freemasonry later gives major symbolic roles to Solomon's Temple, Jachin and Boaz, and all-seeing-eye imagery in different rites and writings. This is a later reception layer and should not be backdated into the biblical text or the official Great Seal explanation.

twin_pillars.use: Jachin/Boaz supply a strong comparator for two supports flanking a Door. The project can use pillar-pairs at important thresholds when two different capacities jointly make passage possible.
twin_pillars.caution: Use Twin Pillars as a threshold-support comparator, not as a claim that Jachin and Boaz structurally supported the Temple roof or secretly encoded project dualities; scholarly interpretation of their original function is contested.

pyramid_mountain.formula: broad base → successive compression → narrow summit
pyramid_mountain.use: The Great Seal pyramid sharpens Mountain as layered abstraction/integration. Each level can compress many lower details into fewer higher-order relations.
pyramid_mountain.unfinished_apex: The unfinished pyramid adds a useful project lesson: built hierarchy/integration can remain incomplete and should not pretend to possess final sight or completion.

eye_above_structure.use: The Eye sits above/outside the pyramid rather than simply being its top block. In Potato topology this supports keeping Eye/discernment separate from Mountain/status/power.
eye_above_structure.caution: Eye symbolism also develops providential, esoteric and surveillance readings in different contexts; the project must type which reading it is using.

foundation_date.formula: source/date at base → later architecture above
foundation_date.use: Dates and primary-source provenance can be rendered at roots/base rather than hidden in footnotes. The 1776 inscription is a model for visible provenance, not mystical numerology.

temple_gate.use: The biblical pillars make the House entrance more legible: not every boundary is a wall; some boundaries announce and stabilize a legitimate passage.

project_corrections.great_book_chapter_97: The legacy Great Book chapter contains claims that conflate documented Freemasonry/Illuminati history with conspiracy interpretation. Preserve it as creative/legacy material, but downstream factual readers should use this atlas for historical corrections and provenance.
project_corrections.dollar_bill: Franklin D. Roosevelt did not create the Great Seal's Eye/pyramid design. The reverse was adopted in 1782; the seal's reverse later appeared on the one-dollar note during the 1930s. Distinguish adoption of the symbol from later currency use.
project_corrections.all_seeing_eye: Do not define the Eye of Providence primarily as elite surveillance/control. The documented Great Seal explanation is providential.

design_consequences: Door may optionally render two flanking supports when a transition genuinely depends on two complementary conditions.
Mountain/pyramid views should show unresolved/incomplete apex states when evidence or synthesis is not complete.
Eye should remain an evaluator/interface above or across structure, not become synonymous with hierarchy.
Archive/base layers should expose dates and source provenance visibly.
Esoteric/reception layers should always be one click deeper than documented historical meaning.
When a symbol has multiple dated receptions, the interface should expose origin → adoption → rendering → later reception rather than one timeless meaning.
Historical visual form can itself evolve after official adoption; provenance should distinguish the legal/verbal device from later graphic renderings.

genealogy.principle: Track each symbol through its own dated lineage first; only then describe where lineages meet through design, reception or project comparison.

eye_providence.fact: The first Great Seal committee included an Eye of Providence in Pierre Eugène Du Simitière's proposal; the final reverse arrangement did not yet exist.
eye_providence.meaning: Providence imagery precedes the adopted 1782 reverse.

eye_providence.fact: Congress adopted the written reverse containing the Eye above the unfinished pyramid, with Annuit Coeptis.
eye_providence.meaning: Providential favor is part of the official national-symbol explanation.

eye_providence.fact: All-seeing-eye imagery also appears in Masonic/esoteric settings with meanings that vary by rite/source.
eye_providence.meaning: Later reception is not automatically the source of the Great Seal eye.

pyramid.fact: The reverse description includes an unfinished pyramid of thirteen courses with MDCCLXXVI at the base.
pyramid.meaning: Thomson associated the pyramid with strength and duration; thirteen corresponds to the original states.

pyramid.fact: James Trenchard produced the first published reverse drawing from the written description.
pyramid.meaning: Later familiar visual details are renderings of the 1782 verbal device, not necessarily original drawn details.

pyramid.fact: Benson J. Lossing's rendering influenced later official visualizations, including eye orientation and pyramid appearance.
pyramid.meaning: Reception/design history matters even inside one official symbol.

pyramid.fact: The reverse later appeared on the one-dollar note.
pyramid.meaning: Currency use is later reception, not origin of the seal design.

date_1776.fact: Congress appointed the first seal committee on July 4, 1776; MDCCLXXVI on the adopted reverse refers to the beginning of the American era/Declaration year.
date_1776.meaning: Founding date belongs to national provenance.

date_1776.fact: The Bavarian Illuminati was founded the same year.
date_1776.meaning: Coincidence alone does not establish design influence or secret authorship.

jachin_boaz.fact: Jachin and Boaz are named bronze pillars at the Temple entrance/porch.
jachin_boaz.meaning: Their original literary/architectural role precedes later Masonic symbolism.

jachin_boaz.fact: Scholars disagree on whether the pillars were structural, freestanding symbolic/ritual elements, or had other architectural meanings.
jachin_boaz.meaning: Do not overstate 'two supports holding the roof' as biblical fact.

jachin_boaz.fact: Freemasonry makes the pillars prominent lodge/initiatory symbols.
jachin_boaz.meaning: This later threshold symbolism is historically separate from the biblical temple context.
